paraphrase: Closed Bool-state controls. The autonomous flip law has exactly two Int solutions, the changing alternation and its one-step re-dating, which differ as dated paths and agree up to dating; constant reason truth does not determine a flip solution and transition tokens do. Adding one dated pin gives a condition with a unique changing solution that is not shift-invariant. The all-true condition is shift-invariant with a unique nonchanging solution, determined by constant truth. These three delete in turn each member of the bundle shift-invariant, unique, changing. Under one autonomous many-valued law, two solutions agree through time 0 and differ at time 1, and tokens before time 0 do not determine the staying-false solution. A path revisiting a state with different successors follows no functional undated law, yet is the unique solution of its dated copy. On a two-point window a one-edge undated law has a unique changing solution, and the swapped law a different one. The flip state relation has a 2-cycle and its solutions are mutually accessible while dated occurrences of the alternation have no cycle and each has a predecessor. These are formal interpretations, not histories of reality.
